name: Tunnel Method
summary: The Tunnel Method EA identifies price tunnel or channel formations and trades breakouts from those defined ranges. It enters positions when price breaks above or below the tunnel boundaries, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves following periods of consolidation.
summary_zh: Tunnel Method EA通过识别价格通道或区间的形成，在价格突破通道边界时进行交易。它在价格突破隧道上下轨时入场，旨在捕获盘整后的动量驱动行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是隧道突破法，即在市场价格形成一定范围的通道（隧道）后，等待价格突破通道的上轨或下轨时入场交易。入场条件通常基于价格收盘突破通道边界确认，突破上轨做多，突破下轨做空。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损、通道反向突破或基于ATR的动态止损。仓位管理一般采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式。资金管理方面，EA可能包含风险比例设置但具体取决于参数配置。整体策略属于典型的区间突破类型，适合在盘整后趋势启动时获利，但在假突破频繁的市场环境中容易产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the tunnel breakout method, which waits for price to break above or below a defined price channel (tunnel) after a period of consolidation. Entry conditions are triggered when price closes beyond the tunnel boundaries — a breakout above the upper band initiates a long position, while a breakout below the lower band triggers a short. Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, a reversal breakout of the tunnel, or ATR-based dynamic stops. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lot sizes or risk-percentage calculations based on account equity. Money management features depend on the parameter configuration but generally include risk ratio settings. The strategy is a classic range-breakout type that profits when trends emerge after consolidation, but it is vulnerable to consecutive losses in markets with frequent false breakouts.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: Close orders with specified magic number (-1=all)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典的通道突破原理，易于理解和验证
在趋势启动初期入场，能够捕捉较大的趋势行情获利
参数相对简洁，便于用户调整和优化策略表现
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on classic channel breakout principles, easy to understand and verify
Enters at the beginning of trend moves, capable of capturing large trending profits for significant gains
Relatively simple parameters, making it easy for users to adjust and optimize strategy performance
cons: 假突破是主要风险，价格短暂突破后回归通道会导致频繁止损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，在震荡市中可能反复触发无效信号造成亏损
仓位管理较为基础，未考虑根据市场波动率动态调整仓位大小
cons_en: False breakouts are the primary risk — price briefly breaking out then returning to the channel causes frequent stop-outs
Lacks trend filtering mechanism, which may repeatedly trigger invalid signals in ranging markets leading to losses
Position sizing is basic, without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (e.g., ATR-based sizing)
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线或ADX）以避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整出场水平
增加突破确认机制（如突破后回踩确认或成交量确认）以降低假突破风险
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA or ADX) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt exit levels to market volatility
Add breakout confirmation mechanisms (e.g., pullback confirmation after breakout or volume confirmation) to reduce false breakout risk

risk_points: 假突破导致连续止损的风险，尤其在窄幅震荡行情中
缺乏多仓位检查可能导致重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损可能在剧烈波动行情中不足以覆盖滑点风险
risk_points_en: Risk of consecutive stop-outs from false breakouts, especially in narrow ranging markets
Lack of multi-position checks may lead to duplicate orders increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to cover slippage risk during volatile market conditions
